children: Bhagat succeeds Atul Khosla, who steps down to pursue a new professional opportunity

Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels has appointed Manish Bhagat as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel, effective 21 September 2026. The appointment follows the resignation of Atul Khosla, which the company's board accepted at its meeting on 17 September.

Khosla tendered his resignation on 17 September, citing a new professional opportunity. He will serve a notice period until 20 December 2026 under his employment terms to facilitate the transition of responsibilities.

Bhagat brings more than 20 years of experience across hospitality, retail, engineering, aviation and aerospace. He is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and a Commerce graduate from Delhi University.
Before joining Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels, Bhagat served as Vice President - Finance at SAMHI Hotels Limited. He has also held roles at Devyani International and InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo).
His experience includes treasury, capital management, debt fundraising, refinancing, financial reporting, audit and compliance.

The board approved the changes during its meeting on 17 September, which began at 7 p.m. and concluded at 7.40 p.m. The company made the disclosures under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with Schedule III.
Bhagat's appointment is governed by the company's Nomination and Remuneration Policy and applicable human resources policies. He is not related to any director of the company.

The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs 166.78 crore in the first quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 154.25 crore in the corresponding quarter of FY26. Consolidated profit after tax stood at Rs 11.49 crore, compared with Rs 13.40 crore a year earlier.
The resignation letter and regulatory disclosures have been filed with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE.
